key_insight: Coding agents can directly search for explicit, interpretable feedback laws for active flow control and achieve performance comparable to or better than DRL.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical alternative for flow-control engineering when simulation budgets are limited and controller interpretability matters.
method: Use a constrained heuristic-learning loop where an agent proposes controller code.
Evaluate each candidate only through the public benchmark simulator interface.
Iteratively revise the executable policy under fixed simulation budgets.
evidence_signal: Across 13 active flow-control benchmarks, the discovered heuristic controllers matched or outperformed the best DRL policy in 10 environments under identical simulation budgets.
watch_item: The approach still depends on iterative simulation-based evaluation, so scalability and robustness may vary with benchmark complexity and implementation quality.
paper_title: Heuristic Learning for Active Flow Control Using Coding Agents
